reason: Manually viewed unchanged primary, full raw master, paired sheet and white/cyan/alpha panels. Approved: source short receding grey/brown parted hair and real brow hair, thick pale grey/white moustache with curled ends, smooth chin, closed serious mouth and slight leftward head angle are retained. Dark open pinstriped suit, white high shirt collar and dark olive/grey-brown tie with muted pale/gold shading remain source-bound; no hidden torso pin was added. Whole yellow head has a rounded short chin immediately contacting the broad raised collar, without separate yellow shaft, pointed funnel, narrow pinching or cream bib. Complete tilted frame, opaque grey photographic backing, cream note and real overlap preserved. White/cyan/alpha panels show solid interior opacity and no missing backing, with alpha only at exterior silhouette. Tie micro-pattern is not claimed as exact from the low-resolution primary. No in-game claim.
